title: JA Restaurant EmDash 1.0.1 reads the design-system type, shape and colour roles, its slot contract is ready and its committed measurement passes every built-site rule
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, run tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-416-emdash-restaurant-ds-ready.mjs: it reads the theme's version, its stylesheets and tokens, the slot contract and contracts/1.0.1/design-system-measurement.json.
expect: The theme is 1.0.1 in package.json, template.config.json and the Dockerfile label.

global.css reads --ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-leading-display and the radius tokens for the display, heading, body, button and card rules, each with the 1.0.0 value as fallback; tokens.css reads neither --ds-c-secondary nor --ds-c-on-ink-soft (pre-fix: ROLE-1 failed under every system and DEF-1 named both roles).
The slot contract is ready from 1.0.1 and the committed 1.0.1 measurement judges every built-site rule pass or not applicable (pre-fix: no 1.0.1 measurement, contract ready false).
evidence: Measured 05-06/11/2026 on sites built from the 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 packages: 1.0.0 passed 29 of 45 design-system rules (4 of 64 flow views); 1.0.1 passes 64 of 64 views and every preview rule, and its Fast Gate tiles are identical to 1.0.0's.
